categories.name: Bridge & Transportation Moulds
categories.description: Custom steel mould systems for precast bridge, viaduct and rail components, available in conventional, hydraulic or movable configurations to suit customer drawings, casting methods, permanent factories and dedicated casting yards.

categories.name: Building Component Moulds
categories.description: Custom steel mould systems for repeat production of structural and architectural building components, with conventional, hydraulic or movable configurations selected to match customer requirements, component geometry and factory workflow.

categories.name: Tunnel & Underground Moulds
categories.description: Purpose-designed tunnel and underground mould systems, customized as conventional, hydraulic or movable configurations according to customer drawings, demoulding requirements and production conditions.

categories.name: Municipal & Infrastructure Moulds
categories.description: Custom mould systems for drainage, utility, road and civil-infrastructure components, available with conventional, hydraulic or movable operation to meet customer-specific geometry, output and handling requirements.
